name: @mebular/desktop
description: Mebular 桌面应用（Electron 壳 + 内嵌控制台 + 守护托管）
author: Windsander

scripts.dist:dir: node scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs && node scripts/prepare-build.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs && node scripts/prepare-build.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --universal --publish never
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs && node scripts/prepare-build.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs && node scripts/prepare-build.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux --x64 --publish never
